$comment: Høst: compound assignments in Julia, such as += and the broadcast form .+=. The Julia grammar gives them the same scope as =, so they would keep the text colour. They compute before they assign and get the structure colour like + and *, while = and .= keep the text colour. Applies outside strings and comments.

patterns.comment: compound assignments, with or without the broadcast dot
patterns.name: keyword.operator.assignment.compound.julia
